transcript: Speaker A: English ke simple rules samajh lo, toh kabhi sawal poochne mein dikkat nahi hogi. 'Who' tab use karna hai jab kisi person ke baare mein jaan na ho... [Understand simple English rules, so you will never have trouble asking questions. Use 'who' to know about a person...] ...Aur agar aapko English mein aur deep jaan na hai, toh English Seekho App download karo. Wahan par experts aur ek AI coach hai... Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. [And if you want to learn English deeply, download the English Seekho App. There are experts and an AI coach... The trial is only for one rupee.]
on_screen_text: English Simple Rules, who -> Person, what -> cheez, where -> place, when -> Time, why -> Reason, how -> Tareeka/condition. English Seekho App, Experts -> aasan bhasha, AI coach -> 24/7, Trial Rs 1, Farratedar English. [English Simple Rules, who -> Person, what -> thing, where -> place, when -> Time, why -> Reason, how -> Method/condition. summary: A teacher explains basic English question words on a smart board before promoting the 'English Seekho' app. He highlights features like expert guidance and a 24/7 AI coach that corrects mistakes. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for a ₹1 trial.
